title: Codex stdin writer can stay blocked after its server exits when a descendant holds the pipe and a write is in flight
outcome: The waiter's ServerExited command queues behind commands already accepted. If a write is in progress, or a command ahead of the marker writes, when the server exits while a surviving descendant still holds the stdin read end, the write can block and the writer never reaches the marker; the watchdog cannot unblock it by ending a server that already exited. Exit could be propagated out of band and writes made interruptible by it.
acceptance: After a Codex app-server exits, its stdin writer ends even when a descendant keeps the pipe's read end open and a write was in flight; a fixture keeping the read end open shows it.
